integrity: The proof exhausts the parity-forced forms of the even and odd members and is independent of finite enumeration. The packaged computation is corroborative only. The local low-multiplicity theorem is separated from known bounded solution tables and global analytic results.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only solutions with both prime-factor multiplicities at most two. It makes no claim about higher multiplicity layers, infinitude, or the global counting function. The 2015 Bayless--Kinlaw source was inspected through a publisher preview, so no whole-document noncoverage claim is made for it.
title: The first two multiplicity layers of consecutive equal totients
